project: Mycroft Phase 5 — Quantitative Thesis Resilience, Contradiction Detection and Stress Testing

advisory: AI-assisted quantitative research and decision support. Not financial advice and not an autonomous trading system.

beats.title: Opening
beats.subtitle: Quantitative Thesis Resilience
beats.narration: Hi, I am Dhrumil Shah, and this video is about Mycroft Phase 5, where I built a quantitative thesis-resilience, contradiction-detection, and stress-testing framework to evaluate the health and risk of investment theses using market data.

beats.title: The change of question
beats.subtitle: From direction to durability
beats.narration: Earlier phases asked: will this stock go up or down? Phase 5 asks something else. Is the quantitative thesis still healthy, what evidence contradicts it, and does it survive stress?

beats.title: Architecture
beats.subtitle: Seven stages
beats.narration: The pipeline runs in seven stages. Market data becomes engineered features. Features become a thesis-health score. The score is watched for contradictions. Names are stress tested. Health and stress combine into a resilience score, and that sets the human review priority.

beats.title: Data and features
beats.subtitle: One validated panel
beats.narration: The input is the same OHLCV panel as earlier phases: one hundred and eighty-four thousand rows, one hundred and twenty tickers, six years. From it the notebook engineers returns, moving-average distance, volatility, volume behaviour, RSI, drawdown, and sector- and market-relative performance.

beats.title: Thesis health score
beats.subtitle: Seven ranked factors
beats.narration: The thesis-health score runs zero to one hundred. Seven factors are ranked cross-sectionally on every date, so a score means the same thing in any market. Twenty-day return carries the most weight, then sector-relative return, distance from the fifty-day average, drawdown, volatility, RSI health, and volume.

beats.title: Thesis states
beats.subtitle: Broken to strong
beats.narration: The score becomes a state. Below thirty-five is broken. Thirty-five to fifty is weakening. Fifty to sixty-five is stable. Above sixty-five is strong. Here is one name's health across six years, crossing those lines again and again.

beats.title: Deterioration
beats.subtitle: Change, not level
beats.narration: Level alone is not enough. The system also tracks the five-day and twenty-day change in health, and whether a name has dropped to a worse state than it held twenty days ago. Direction of travel matters as much as position.

beats.title: Contradiction detection
beats.subtitle: Looking for the counter-evidence
beats.narration: Contradiction detection is the heart of Phase 5. A thesis should not only gather support, it should hunt for evidence against itself. A name is flagged when health falls twenty points in twenty days, or it weakens while trailing its sector, or it sits well below its fifty-day average in a deep drawdown. Every flag carries its reasons in plain text.

beats.title: Stress testing
beats.subtitle: Bootstrap simulation
beats.narration: Then the stress test. For each name the notebook estimates a beta to the equal-weighted dataset market, separates the idiosyncratic part of its returns, and bootstraps three thousand twenty-day paths from real history, with volatility multiplied by one point eight and an eight percent market shock on the first day.

beats.title: VaR and CVaR
beats.subtitle: Threshold and severity
beats.narration: That gives a loss distribution and two tail numbers. Value at risk is the threshold the worst five percent of paths fall beyond. Conditional value at risk is their average, how bad it gets past that line. For Oracle: a forty-six percent threshold, averaging fifty-two.

beats.title: Resilience score
beats.subtitle: Health meets stress
beats.narration: Health and stress then combine. Fifty-five percent thesis health, twenty percent the chance of avoiding a loss, fifteen percent the chance of avoiding a severe one, and ten percent the volatility rank. The result bands into fragile, watch, resilient, and high resilience.

beats.title: Review queue
beats.subtitle: What to look at first
beats.narration: Everything lands in one ranked queue: three points for a contradiction, two each for a weak band, a sharp health drop, and a high chance of severe loss. On the latest day, seventeen names reached the top priority of nine.

beats.title: Honest diagnostic
beats.subtitle: What the flag is worth
beats.narration: And an honest measurement. Across the whole history, flagged rows saw large five-day moves twenty-two percent of the time, against nineteen percent for unflagged rows. A real difference, but a small one, and the flag fires on about a third of all rows. This is a diagnostic, not a forecast.

beats.title: Close
beats.subtitle: Decision support, not decisions
beats.narration: Phase three built multi-agent market intelligence. Phase four made it regime-aware. Phase five moves past predicting direction: it asks whether a thesis still holds, finds the evidence against it, tests it under stress, and ranks what a human should check first. Research decision support, not financial advice. Thank you for watching. This was Mycroft Phase 5.
